question: Paid SaaS: "DocuSign". What people pay it for: Send a document for signature over a one-time link, record every event against it, and produce a signed PDF with an appended certificate page listing the hashes, timestamps and consent text. Question: is the candidate below an open-source or self-hostable application (web, desktop or server) that a person could actually use INSTEAD of DocuSign for that job, or for a clear, substantial part of it? Partial replacements count as yes (for example a desktop video editor for a video app, a self-hosted rank tracker for an SEO suite). Answer no for: a code library or SDK only, a command-line utility with no end-user workflow, a closed paid service, a tutorial, or a tool for an unrelated job.
